description: Order the part made: creates the production request and returns a pay_url for the user. Propose the manufacturing method from the user's words and the part, pass it as method with a one-line reason. The price is the real maker price; never invent or send one. Tell the user the card is only held, and a person confirms the final price before charging. If the result is status "pricing", the price is still being worked out: call again in a few seconds.

method.description: How the part should be made. Propose it from the user's words and the part (flat sheet: laser_cut or sheetmetal; metal block: cnc; plastic: fdm_print or resin_print).

material.description: Only a material the user named.

slug.description: Saved project slug (from open_in_studio or a /p/<slug> link). Send slug or source, not both.

source.description: The kernelCAD script, when the part is not saved. Send slug or source, not both.

name: order_part
title: Order Part
